exitCodes.meaning: Done. list: {stashes:[…]}, newest first. push: the new stash@{0}. apply/pop: {oid, outcome:"applied"}. drop: {dropped: oid}. Each mutating subcommand is one journal entry.
Invalid arguments — no or an unknown subcommand, a flag another subcommand owns, a missing or extra <stash>, or a duplicated flag. <stash> is stash@{n}, n, or a full oid from stash list.
The request failed for a reason the other codes do not name.

Not a repository; no commits; nothing to stash; unresolved conflicts; an intent-to-add path; a <stash> the list does not hold; or git refused the apply (local changes or an untracked file in the way, --index not applicable).
apply or pop conflicted (blocked_on_conflicts) — ok:true, outcome "conflicted", conflictedPaths listed; git applied what it could and kept the stash. Resolve, or undo.

flags.help: With push: stash untracked files too (git's default is not to).
With apply or pop: bring staged changes back staged, not unstaged.

summary: List, push, apply, pop or drop stashes. A subcommand is required.
